test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are three consecutive road crossings at which traffic lights change after every 35 seconds, 42 seconds and 90 seconds, respectively. If the lights are set on simultaneously at 8:00:00 hours, then after how much time will they change again simultaneously?
solution:
**Given:**

Traffic Lights change after every 35, 42 & 90 seconds

Initial time = 8:00:00 hours

**Concept used:**

LCM = Least Common Multiple

It is the product of the greatest power of each prime factor, involved in the numbers.
